business.reason: Implement U02/U03/U04 only: printer-scoped alternative approvals, expiry before start, parallel checks, eligible FIFO, independent versions and selected-run cancellation.

state_machine.reason: Executor consumes bo_stategraph/declaration.py. SQLite writer transaction owns shared printer occupancy and queue; all transaction snapshots checked with the project shared-resource extension.

abstraction.reason: Stable business IDs retain round-01 meaning; all implementation functions including transaction callbacks bind to current source, static auxiliaries remain under analysis details.

probes.reason: Commit probes follow SQLite commit. Actual parameters, predicate flags, wait reasons and effect IDs are compared independently; overridden checker functions are attributed to the actual worker/callback, not falsely to the default checker.
